coverage: shared integrated composition in HTML and wikitext
real nested DOM repaint through cold, cached, progress, final and storage updates
last-good counter values and verified creation metadata
date-input drafts, validation state and focus
visibility, field placement, legacy arrangements and one footer
installer options, local editors and installation checker with simulated responses
build, release manifests, hashes, destinations and copy/download controls

checks: independent field placement and internal wikilinks
spacing, columns, counter and name alignment
only cards and only activity with one invitation
separate/grouped/integrated layout round trip with retained block order
complete profile export and duplicate guard in local editor
no Wikipedia editors, checker network, clipboard writes or publishing

css.method: Actual local run of Wikimedia CSS parser, StylePropertySanitizer and selector grammar with the TemplateStyles rule construction used by this stylesheet. No site-specific Wikimedia hooks are loaded. Existing dependencies were read locally, fetch was blocked, no wiki was opened.

limitations: Synthetic local data only. No public APIs or real Commons photos were used in browser checks.
Native Firefox and Safari were not rerun for this candidate.
